name_zh: 乌拉圭·塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯：肿瘤医生总统与癌症烟草合法健康
name_en: Uruguay Tabare Vazquez: Oncologist President & Cancer Tobacco Legal Health
description_zh: 塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯 (1940-2020) 乌拉圭首位左翼总统 (2005-2010, 2015-2020)，肿瘤科医生推动严格烟草控制法案，世界首个全面禁烟国家，癌症治疗公共化，2014年合法化大麻国家管控。
description_en: Tabare Vazquez (1940-2020) Uruguay first leftist President (2005-2010, 2015-2020), oncologist pushed strict tobacco control law, world first comprehensive smoke-free nation, cancer treatment publicized, 2014 legalized marijuana state control.
reason_zh: 巴斯克斯代表医生总统如何将医学专业知识转化为公共卫生政策，展示了烟草控制与大麻合法化双重公共卫生创新如何在小国实现，其肿瘤医生身份为政策提供了不可置疑的专业权威。
reason_en: Vazquez represents how doctor President transforms medical expertise into public health policy, demonstrating how tobacco control and marijuana legalization dual public health innovation achieved in small nation, his oncologist identity providing unquestionable professional authority for policy.
steps_zh: 研究巴斯克斯早年肿瘤医生与广阔阵线创建
分析2006年烟草控制法案世界首个全面禁烟
探讨癌症治疗纳入公共医疗体系与筛查普及
评估2014年大麻合法化国家管控模式创新
总结肿瘤医生总统癌症烟草合法健康对全球公共卫生治理的示范
steps_en: Study Vazquez early oncologist and Broad Front founding
Analyze 2006 tobacco control law world first comprehensive smoke-free
Explore cancer treatment public healthcare integration and screening普及
Evaluate 2014 marijuana legalization state control model innovation
Summarize oncologist president cancer tobacco legal health demonstration for global public health governance
expected_zh: 掌握医学专业权威如何转化为公共政策立法动力，理解烟草禁令与大麻管控双重公共卫生创新的互补逻辑，评估巴斯克斯模式对智利阿根廷等邻国卫生政策的外溢影响。
expected_en: Master how medical professional authority transforms into public policy legislative drive, grasp tobacco ban and marijuana control dual public health innovation complementary logic, evaluate Vazquez model spillover impact on Chile Argentina neighbors health policies.
case_zh: 2005 总统；2006 禁烟；2014 大麻合法；2020 逝世。肿瘤医生总统癌症烟草合法范式永存。
case_en: 2005 President; 2006 smoke-free; 2014 marijuana legal; 2020 death. Oncologist president cancer tobacco legal paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Tobacco control; marijuana legalization; cancer care; doctor politician
